prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates across all dimensions: perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonality correlation (0.2912), and lowest RMSE (172.99). The extreme rmse_spread_ratio (19.53) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to decompose and recombine trend/seasonal components while exploiting the clear pattern separation shown in the STL analysis.
